changelog: Synced all upstream improvements from Santoshkurmi/antigem through 57a71e4 while preserving 100% of LytsoCoder features, branding, ports, AI permissions, and isolated OpenCode/Antigravity System Prompt architecture

OpenCode model variants, thinking effort levels & dynamic model capabilities discovery (capabilities.go, OpenCodeChatBackend, OpenCodeChatUi, OpenCodeSettingsScreen) alongside LytsoCoder's live exclusive systemInstruction plugin
Full Ubuntu chroot runtime support (ChrootManager, ChrootInstaller, X11, REA, Android Dev, and dedicated -chroot APK build)
Shizuku & Root device access modes alongside ADB (DeviceAccess, ShizukuShell, RootShell)
Home screen widgets (Chats, Quick actions, One chat, Scripts) & app shortcuts, Jarvis floating orb, floating Voice Call window & QS tile

Agent step grouping pill (configurable minimum steps), optional message stats toggle, floating switcher icon customization & Page Overview, Terminal Sessions Drawer & emulator/input fixes, enhanced Notes scrolling, custom back-to-background navigation, Android 7/8 (API 24/25) core library desugaring & fallback launcher icons, and beta update channel support
